provenance.method: Curated atomic synthesis from authoritative standards, institutional references and editorial consensus; no verbatim source passages embedded.

warnings: Oceanographic properties are strongly dependent on depth, region, season and reference frame. Conventional depth zones and named water masses are useful abstractions, not universal discontinuities.
